title: Senior Azure Cloud Architect
description:
*EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi\-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting\-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.*


We are seeking a highly experienced **Senior Azure Cloud Architect** to lead the design and delivery of enterprise\-scale cloud platforms and next\-generation AI solutions. In this role, you will drive cloud transformation initiatives, architect innovative Azure\-based solutions, and provide technical leadership across complex modernization programs. You will collaborate with senior stakeholders, presales teams, and engineering groups to shape scalable, secure, and future\-ready architectures.

**Responsibilities**

* Architect enterprise\-scale Azure cloud platforms and landing zones covering subscriptions, management groups, networking, identity, security, governance, monitoring, and automation
* Design scalable, secure, and highly available solutions using Azure services such as AKS, App Service, Azure Functions, API Management, Event Grid, Service Bus, Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, Storage, and related PaaS services
* Define cloud\-native and application modernization strategies including re\-platforming, re\-architecting, containerization, microservices, and event\-driven architectures
* Provide architecture guidance for migration and modernization of large\-scale enterprise workloads to Azure
* Design and integrate Azure OpenAI and GenAI solutions including enterprise AI assistants, RAG\-based solutions, intelligent search, copilots, and AI\-enabled business applications
* Define patterns for integrating Azure OpenAI with enterprise applications, APIs, data platforms, and knowledge repositories
* Ensure appropriate architecture around AI security, identity, data privacy, responsible AI, observability, and governance
* Lead architecture workshops and technical discussions with customers, application teams, infrastructure teams, security teams, and senior stakeholders
* Develop reference architectures, architecture blueprints, design standards, and reusable cloud patterns
* Participate in RFP/RFI responses, solution proposals, technical estimations, architecture presentations, and customer pitches
* Support presales teams in defining solution scope, architecture, delivery approach, effort estimates, assumptions, and technical risks
* Conduct architecture reviews, provide technical governance across cloud transformation programs, and mentor architects and engineering teams across multiple projects or workstreams

**Requirements**

* 16\-22 years of overall IT experience with significant experience in cloud and enterprise architecture roles
* Strong hands\-on architectural expertise in Microsoft Azure
* Deep understanding of Azure platform and systems architecture, including Azure Landing Zones, Management Groups, and Subscriptions
* Proficiency in Hub\-Spoke/Virtual WAN architectures, networking, and private connectivity
* Knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, Managed Identities, and Azure Policy, along with RBAC, governance, security, monitoring, and observability
* Skills in Azure PaaS and cloud\-native technologies including AKS/Kubernetes, containers, and App Service
* Familiarity with Azure Functions, API Management, Service Bus, and Event Grid
* Competency in Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, Storage, and related managed services
* Background in microservices, APIs, and distributed systems, along with integration patterns and event\-driven architectures
* Experience designing application modernization and cloud migration strategies for large enterprise environments
* Expertise in Azure OpenAI Service and GenAI architecture, including integration of LLM\-based capabilities into enterprise applications
* Understanding of RAG, embeddings, and vector search, as well as prompt orchestration, AI agents, and enterprise GenAI architecture patterns
* Consulting and customer\-facing experience with the ability to engage senior technical and business stakeholders, participate in RFPs, RFIs, presales solutioning, estimations, and technical proposal development
* Capability to translate business requirements into scalable and practical cloud architecture

**Nice to have**

* Experience with Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, and Azure Machine Learning
* Background in FinOps and cloud cost optimization
* Exposure to large\-scale cloud migration or modernization programs
* Microsoft Azure Architect or other relevant cloud certifications
* Experience working with global enterprise customers or distributed engineering teams

**We offer**

* Opportunity to work on technical challenges that may impact across geographies
* Vast opportunities for self\-development: online university, knowledge sharing opportunities globally, learning opportunities through external certifications
* Opportunity to share your ideas on international platforms
* Sponsored Tech Talks \& Hackathons
* Unlimited access to LinkedIn learning solutions
* Possibility to relocate to any EPAM office for short and long\-term projects
* Focused individual development
* Benefit package:
	+ Health benefits
	+ Retirement benefits
	+ Paid time off
	+ Flexible benefits
* Forums to explore beyond work passion (CSR, photography, painting, sports, etc.)

title: Distributed Application Support
description:
**About Our Company**


Ameriprise India LLP has been providing client based financial solutions to help clients plan and achieve their financial objectives for 20 years. We are part of Ameriprise Financial Inc., a US financial planning company headquartered in Minneapolis with a global presence and diversified financial services leader with more than $1\.5 trillion in assets under management, administration and advisement as of year\-end 2024\. The firm’s focus areas include Asset Management and Advice, Retirement Planning and Insurance Protection.


Be part of an inclusive, collaborative culture that rewards you for your contributions, and work with other talented individuals who share your passion for doing great work. You’ll also have plenty of opportunities to make your mark at the office and a difference in your community. So, if you're talented, driven and want to work for a strong, ethical company that cares, take the next step and create a career at Ameriprise India LLP.

**Job Description**


In this role the person will be the responsible for ensuring success of business critical application operations by supporting the day to day batch processing, analyzing and fixing the issues on priority while adhering to standards and SLA's. The person should be able to support High priority(P1/P2\) incidents dynamically by providing timely resolution for the problem and handle other service requests. The person will also be responsible for handling minor enhancements, perform code reviews, handle application outages(planned/unplanned) and responsible for performance and maintenance of the highly critical business application. For this role we are looking for a highly motivated Individual who will be working as Sr. operations analysts working in technologies. The person should exhibit leadership qualities and demonstrate business acumen while working closely with business users to understand requirements and help team translate it into technical changes.  

Provide end to end production support and derive immediate resolutions/root\-cause of the incidents arising in and around the Legal, Compliance and Supervision Application’s Distributed systems to ensure quick restoration of service degradation and hence minimal business impact.**Key Responsibilities**

* Work as part of Operations team primarily supporting the Distributed applications
* Respond to incidents as well as work to identify proactive incident circumvention
* Support the Batch Operations that occurs nightly for Distributed systems
* Work on rotation basis during the day and night Operations shift to support both night batches and the day time Operations work alternatively
* Identify and recommend performance enhancements/improvements for applications
* Provide 24x7 on\-call support and work during hours that accommodate a portion of the US work day or during the full US work day shift (India night shift) including weekends / holidays


Incident \& Problem Management

* Work towards quick resolution/recovery of the high priority incidents in a time\-bound manner to ensure business continuity and minimum downtimes
* Coordinate and drive restoration of service disruptions/business escalated issues to meet and exceed established SLAs/OLAs
* Ensure action plans are in place to address recurring issues, including escalation and effective hand\-off to other teams as required
* Work towards aggressive root cause analysis/permanent resolution for all the business impacting recurring technical issues


Change Management

* Participate in change reviews and understand operational impacts due to changes
* Continuous Service Improvement Initiatives
* Improve effectiveness and efficiency of existing processes
* Follow best practices to enhance service delivery
* Develop the ability to think and act strategically
* Engage in the business and technology interactions to improve the service quality
* Ensure appropriate quality checks to decrease the risks and errors
* Ensure to execute processes to optimize cost and quality

  

  

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, MIS, Information Technology, or equivalent experience.
* 4\-8 years of experience in Production Support, Application Operations, Cloud Operations, or Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) roles.
* Strong experience supporting distributed applications in Production environments.
* Hands\-on experience troubleshooting applications hosted in AWS Cloud environments including EC2, S3, Lambda, SNS, SQS, RDS and CloudWatch.
* Strong experience with: SQL and database troubleshooting Windows Server and Linux administration Java and/or .NET application support Enterprise batch scheduling platforms such as TWS (IBM Workload Scheduler), Tidal, Control\-M or equivalent
* Practical scripting experience with Bash Shell and PowerShell for production support, troubleshooting, operational automation, monitoring and batch processing.
* Experience automating manual operational tasks using PowerShell, Bash, Python or AWS native automation services.
* Experience supporting ETL workflows, data pipelines, file transfers and batch processing environments.
* Experience using monitoring and observability tools such as Dynatrace, Sumo Logic, CloudWatch or equivalent.
* Strong understanding of ITIL practices including Incident, Problem and Change Management.
* Proven experience in root cause analysis, service restoration and proactive incident prevention.

 **Preferred Qualifications**  

Candidates who have used following tools (or have familiarity with below) will have added advantage:•

* AWS Certified SysOps Administrator Associate (Highly Preferred)
* AWS Certified Solutions Architect Associate (Optional)
* ITIL Foundation Certification
* Experience supporting financial services, compliance, supervision, legal, or highly regulated applications.
* Experience with: AWS Cloud Operations DevOps and CI/CD concepts Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/CloudFormation) Python automation development
* Knowledge of ETL platforms such as Informatica, AWS Glue, IDMC, or equivalent.
* Experience building operational dashboards, monitoring solutions, and automated alerting mechanisms.
* Knowledge of Mainframe environments and scheduling integrations is a plus.
* Proven track record of identifying automation opportunities and reducing operational overhead through scripting and process improvements.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with a proactive operational mindset

**In\-Office Collaboration**

* We are a client\-centric, relationship\-based business. Working together, in\-person, is foundational to how we achieve results. By fostering a culture of face\-to\-face collaboration, idea sharing, productivity and personal connection, we deliver for our stakeholders — clients, advisors, employees and shareholders. Our employees work in the office at least three (3\) days per week, with flexibility to work from home two (2\) days per week. Some roles may require additional in\-office time or different in\-office expectations, and specific requirements will be discussed during the hiring process.

* Experience leading large\-scale and heterogeneous database migration programs
* Strong knowledge of SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL or similar enterprise relational databases
* Experience with database modernization, schema conversion, data migration, performance tuning and query optimization
* Strong understanding of AWS networking, IAM, security, encryption, monitoring, backup, high availability and disaster recovery concepts
* Experience defining migration strategies, migration waves, cutover plans, rollback procedures, validation approaches and migration runbooks

title: Director Investment Technology
description:
**About Our Company**


Ameriprise India LLP has been providing client based financial solutions to help clients plan and achieve their financial objectives for 20 years. We are part of Ameriprise Financial Inc., a US financial planning company headquartered in Minneapolis with a global presence and diversified financial services leader with more than $1\.5 trillion in assets under management, administration and advisement as of year\-end 2024\. The firm’s focus areas include Asset Management and Advice, Retirement Planning and Insurance Protection.


Be part of an inclusive, collaborative culture that rewards you for your contributions, and work with other talented individuals who share your passion for doing great work. You’ll also have plenty of opportunities to make your mark at the office and a difference in your community. So, if you're talented, driven and want to work for a strong, ethical company that cares, take the next step and create a career at Ameriprise India LLP.

**Job Description**


This is a hands\-on senior technology leadership role supporting the development and implementation of advanced analytics across Investment technology stacks, engaging directly with global stakeholders across Investments, Trading, Investment Operations, Products, Vendors, and wider technology teams. The role requires strong hands\-on engineering craft in Java and Python, alongside strategic leadership.  

This includes leveraging Generative AI, Big Data, Machine Learning, and other cutting\-edge Distributed Technology Stack with Full\-stack Development practices. Provide strategic ideas and thought leadership with practical AI fluency — a clear, evidence\-based view of what works, what doesn't, and how to apply it. Applies solid financial industry business knowledge to support decision and strategy solutions in key business areas. Demonstrates strong technical/problem solving skills. Manages multiple projects collaboratively. Mentor the team members and lay out their collective path for growth.**Job Responsibilities**

* **Strategic Technology Leadership:** Define and drive technology strategy aligned with Investments business goals. Identify opportunities for value creation through cloud\-native architecture, data enablement, and full\-stack engineering solutions.
* **Hands\-On Engineering Leadership:** Remain hands\-on in Java and Python. Set the engineering bar across code quality, architecture, resilience, and cost efficiency. Contribute directly to design and implementation of critical components alongside leading the team.
* **Cloud \& Data Enablement:** Lead initiatives that leverage AWS services (e.g., S3, Glue, Athena, Lambda, ECS) to build scalable, secure, and cost\-effective platforms for investment analytics, reporting, and modeling.
* **Practical AI Fluency \& Application:** Bring a pragmatic, evidence\-based view on AI/GenAI adoption. Identify, prototype, and productionise GenAI use cases in investment workflows, with a clear approach to guardrails, evaluation, cost, and latency trade\-offs.
* **Domain\-Driven Engineering:** Translate complex investment domain problems into actionable engineering solutions. Collaborate with business stakeholders to define problem statements and deliver high\-impact technology outcomes.
* **Solution Architecture \& Modeling:** Oversee the design and implementation of decision logic systems that support investment decision\-making and portfolio management.
* **Delivery Excellence:** Ensure timely and high\-quality delivery of engineering solutions. Manage prioritization across multiple initiatives in a matrixed environment, balancing strategic and tactical needs.
* **Senior Stakeholder Engagement:** Operate credibly with senior technology and business leaders. Able to be brought into detailed working sessions with other senior tech leaders on strategy, architecture, and delivery, and influence decisions through clear, business\-aligned communication.
* **Team Development \& Culture:** Build and nurture a high\-performing global engineering team. Promote a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous learning. Lead performance management, coaching, and recruitment efforts.
* **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with analytics, product, and business teams to co\-create solutions. Drive alignment across technology and business functions to support flagship initiatives.
* **Full Stack Engineering Oversight:** Lead and personally contribute to development across front\-end (React, Angular), back\-end (Java, Node.js, Python), and data layers. Ensure robust, maintainable, and scalable codebases aligned with cloud\-native principles.
* **Cloud Platform Strategy:** Provide inputs and implement AWS\-based solutions for data ingestion, processing, and visualization. Optimize cloud usage for performance and cost efficiency.
* **Investment Technology Expertise:** Apply deep domain knowledge in investment products, portfolio analytics, and financial advisory to guide technology decisions and solution design.
* **Advanced Analytics Enablement:** Collaborate with data science and analytics teams to build operational metrics, dashboards, and reporting tools that support investment insights and decision\-making.
* **Stakeholder Engagement:** Communicate technical strategies and analytical findings to senior leadership in a clear, business\-aligned manner. Influence decision\-making through data\-driven insights.
* **Project \& Change Leadership:** Lead strategic, cross\-functional initiatives that drive transformation in investment technology. Ensure structured execution and measurable outcomes.
* **Governance \& Compliance:** Ensure engineering practices adhere to regulatory, compliance, and security standards. Promote best practices in data governance and software development lifecycle.
* **Team Leadership:** Provide direction and mentorship to a distributed team. Foster collaboration, innovation, and ownership across geographies and time zones.

**Technical Expertise**

* 15\+ years of progressive experience in software engineering, with at least 5\-7 years in a leadership role managing engineering teams, while remaining hands\-on in code and architecture.
* Strong hands\-on command of Java and Python, alongside proven experience in full stack development, including modern front\-end frameworks (e.g., React, Angular), back\-end technologies (e.g., Java, Node.js, Python), and database systems (SQL and NoSQL).
* Strong hands\-on experience with AWS Cloud Platform, including services such as EC2, S3, Lambda, Glue, Athena, RDS, ECS, and CloudFormation.
* Deep understanding of cloud\-native architecture, microservices, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, and DevOps practices.
* Practical AI fluency — demonstrated experience designing and deploying Generative AI solutions, including use of LLMs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Amazon Bedrock), with a clear point of view on what works in production.
* Familiarity with GenAI use cases in financial services such as automated reporting, intelligent document processing, investment insights generation, and conversational interfaces.

**Domain Knowledge**

* Solid understanding of Investments Technology, including financial advisory platforms, portfolio management systems, trading workflows, and investment analytics. Investment functional experience preferred; other financial services (e.g., Investment Banking, Wealth Management) acceptable if technically very strong.
* Experience working with financial data, modeling, and reporting in regulated environments.
* Familiarity with financial products (e.g., mutual funds, ETFs, annuities, insurance) and investment lifecycle processes.

**Leadership \& Strategy**

* Demonstrated ability to **d**efine and execute technology strategy aligned with business goals.
* Experience leading global, cross\-functional engineering teams, including mentoring, performance management, and talent development.
* Proven track record of delivering complex, strategic initiatives in a matrixed organization.
* Proven ability to engage senior technology and business stakeholders in detailed technical and strategic discussions — someone who can be brought into deep\-dive sessions with other senior tech leaders.

**Analytical \& Communication Skills**

* Strong analytical mindset with experience in data enablement, metrics development, and predictive modeling.
* Ability to translate technical concepts into business\-relevant insights and communicate effectively with senior leadership.
* Experience collaborating with analytics, product, and business teams to co\-create solutions.

**Education \& Certifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Preferred: Certifications in AWS (e.g., AWS Solutions Architect, AWS DevOps Engineer) and/or Agile methodologies.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in organizational change management
* Exposure to Generative AI and its implementation, challenges, and methodologies
